plan.line: a water level sensor: a board with bare metal strips that gives a rough reading of how deep it is in water (0 to about 4 cm), or simply whether it is wet (rain, a leak, a full cup). Only the striped end may get wet. It rusts if left in water for days. Uses one of the three ADC pins (shared with knobs).

code.pinLine: water level sensor {ref} on {gpio}: ADC({g}). read_u16() is near 0 when dry and rises as more of its strips are under water (not linear: find the levels by printing readings with the sensor dry, half in and fully in water). Not Pin({g}): a Pin has no read_u16().
